top_choice_rationale: P002 gives Katori and Ye the optical lattice clock: a sharply defined invention (the magic-wavelength lattice that removes Doppler and recoil shifts without perturbing the clock transition) realised to 10^-18 systematic uncertainty and reproduced and compared across independent laboratories. The two-name credit follows the logic of concept plus limiting performance and can be cited without any first or only claim. P001 (magic-angle graphene) is a close second as a possibly larger new regime, but its three-name set omits the first authors of the 2018 experiments and the pairing mechanism remains open, so it is the harder citation to defend. Either is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No documented collaboration with Katori or Ye, nor with the credited names in P001; my documented collaborators are not credited in either proposal. General field proximity to atomic structure and precision theory is noted for P002, but no recusal is apparent from the profile.
